title: precheck's 60 s timeout names no cause or next step
what: When types and lint time out or cannot start, precheck says which tool, whether it is missing, and the next step (install command or `relay doctor`).
why: Found 30 Oct by the trial of relay on a copy of relay cleaned of relay (owner, 30 Oct: "Полагаю что для текущих задач будет не лишним проверить подключение relay к самому relay, очищенному от relay"); sandbox HOME, RELAY_HOME and RELAY_PROJECTS, claude stubbed. `relay precheck` in a task worktree printed 'RED types and lint / FAIL types and lint took longer than 60 s' (about 2 min, rc 1) with no reason; relay doctor in the same sandbox said mypy was not found and the uv cache was cold; the message says neither.
failing_case: Sandbox with no mypy: `relay precheck` in a worktree prints only 'types and lint took longer than 60 s'.
pass_cases: with mypy missing, precheck names mypy and the install step
a real timeout names the tool that was still running
a green precheck prints as today
